title: MEVA (Multiview Extended Video with Activities), release r13, ground cameras
licence_stated: CC BY 4.0 (the LICENSE file of the meva-data-repo)
attribution: "Multiview Extended Video with Activities" (MEVA) dataset by Kitware Inc. and the Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA); Corona et al., MEVA: A Large-Scale Multiview, Multimodal Video Dataset for Activity Detection, WACV 2021
taken: the 42 clips of cameras G336, G341 and G436 on 12 March 2018 that begin from 10:00 to before 11:15 (the 10:35 clip is missing for all three), and Kitware's activity labels of each (the two official sets, kitware and kitware-meva-training, and status.csv); about 5.8 GB
formats: H.264 in AVI, no audio, 1920x1080 at 30 fps, five-minute clips named YYYY-MM-DD.HH-MM-SS.HH-MM-SS.site.Gnnn.r13.avi in local time; labels in KPF YAML
truth: per clip, each activity with its type, status and span in frames
verified: 2026-11-08: the bucket listing, a clip and the label files answer with no account

title: Caltech Camera Traps (LILA BC): trail-camera images from 140 locations in the south-western United States
licence_stated: Community Data License Agreement, permissive variant 1.0 (the LILA BC dataset page)
attribution: Caltech Camera Traps, hosted by LILA BC (https://lila.science); Beery, Van Horn and Perona, Recognition in Terra Incognita, ECCV 2018
taken: the labels file and the 4,256 photos of location 23 (10 September 2013 to 28 February 2014, 1.9 GB); each photo's species label and capture time
formats: JPEG 2048x1494 with the EXIF stripped, UUID file names; COCO Camera Traps JSON
truth: per photo: one label (a species or empty), date_captured to the second, location
verified: 2026-11-08: the labels file and an image answer with no account

title: SINS database: a week of continuous audio of one person in a vacation home, node 7 (the living room)
download: audio: https://zenodo.org/api/records/2547315/files/Node7_audio_01.zip/content to _10.zip (zips of WAV, read by HTTP Range); labels: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KULeuvenADVISE/SINS_database/master/annotation/
licence_stated: two statements that disagree: the Zenodo record says CC BY 4.0, but the license.pdf in the record grants a non-transferable licence for academic research only, with no transfer to third parties and no commercial use without a licence. MMSB follows the stricter one: it never copies or hosts the data and `mmsb fetch` downloads it from Zenodo for the user
attribution: KU Leuven ADVISE and VUB ETRO as providers; Dekkers et al., The SINS database for detection of daily activities in a home environment using an acoustic sensor network, DCASE 2017 Workshop (the reference its licence requires)
taken: the 1,441 minute files of node 7 that play in 2 February 2017 (24 hours), all four channels, and the labels files labels.csv and living_labels.csv; about 4.9 GB read from Zenodo, 3.3 GB kept as lossless FLAC
formats: zips of WAV, 16-bit, 16 kHz, 4 channels, one file of about 60 s per minute, named Node7_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_mmm_audio.wav; labels as Class;Start time;Stop time
truth: activity labels with millisecond wall-clock times (living room activities, and the whole home's, with absence and visits)
verified: 2026-11-08: the zips answer by Range with no account

title: FSD50K (Fonseca et al.), the Hugging Face mirror Fhrozen/FSD50k
licence_stated: CC BY 4.0 for the dataset as a whole (its LICENSE-DATASET.md); each clip is CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC Sampling+ (metadata/eval_clips_info_FSD50K.json says which)
attribution: Fonseca, Favory, Pons, Font and Serra, FSD50K: an open dataset of human-labeled sound events, IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing, 2022; the clips are Freesound users' recordings
taken: the labels, the vocabulary, the raters' judgements and the 10,231 clips of the evaluation split (8.8 GB); about 6,100 of the clips go into a full-size dump
formats: WAV, 16-bit mono 44.1 kHz; CSV labels; JSON metadata
truth: clip-level labels of 200 AudioSet classes, checked by people and exhaustive in the evaluation split; no onsets
verified: 2026-11-08: the labels and a clip answer with no account

title: EgoLife (EgoLifeQA over the video of Jake's smart glasses)
download: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmms-lab/EgoLife (A1_JAKE, EgoLifeQA, EgoLifeCap); the user downloads it and gives its folder as `mmsb build --source`. `mmsb fetch` does not fetch it
licence_stated: MIT (the licence field of the Hugging Face dataset card)
attribution: the EgoLife paper, EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant (arXiv 2503.03803), and its authors
taken: the clips of days 1 to 3 of A1_JAKE, the questions of EgoLifeQA_A1_JAKE.json and the transcripts of EgoLifeCap; about 41 GB
formats: 30 s MP4 clips named DAYn_A1_JAKE_HHMMSSFF.mp4; questions as JSON; transcripts as SRT
full_size: six people's days; the A1_JAKE part is what is used
verified: 2026-11-08: the dataset's listing and card answer with no account
